requestedText: Record the module-local coverage boundary for the WR-012 immutable publication receipt and same-snapshot retry behavior.

evidence: The module-local test uses only an injected in-memory transport and fixed clock; it does not load runtime files, call a provider, or schedule delivery.
The test is compiled as module-local coverage and has no external runtime consumer or provider dependency.
The test does not add telemetry, monitoring, polling, webhook, persistence, or automatic retry behavior.
The Contract authorizes the test evidence and restricts the test to deterministic local coverage of the receipt/retry boundary.
